title: Rich Dad Alternatives
h1: Rich Dad alternatives after you finish the book
keyLine: The book changes how you see a job. It does not teach you to buy a house.
description: What to read or buy after Rich Dad Poor Dad: BiggerPockets, Tax-Free Wealth, Money Guy, a CPA class, or a written plan. Public prices, no invented results.
answer: Rich Dad Poor Dad is a mindset book by Robert Kiyosaki. The [Rich Dad site](https://www.richdad.com/) still sells that view: your house can be a liability, some debt can buy assets, school trains workers. That is a story, not a how-to. After the book, most people need mechanics: how to read a lease, how to run rental math, how tax works. Those live in other products. Some are cheap. Some hide the price on a sales call.
criteriaIntro: We looked at what Rich Dad's own company sells today, then at teachers people actually use next. We did not guess old seminar prices from years ago.
criteria: The option is a book, a cheap class, a community, or a licensed tax teacher we could verify.
We opened a Rich Dad URL for any Rich Dad price we quote.
We separate the book from later coaching funnels.
We include our program and say we sell it.

blocks.heading: What Rich Dad sells now
paragraphs: The book is the core product. People still argue about it. [BiggerPockets has published posts](https://www.biggerpockets.com/blog/rich-dad-poor-dad-investing-principles-good-or-bad) saying the book is motivation, not a manual. That matches how we use it: a start, not a process.

Rich Dad also sells small digital offers. A [Wealth Experts membership page](https://study.richdad.com/we-offer?oid=741&source_id=website_investing_RDWE) listed a 14-day trial, then $17 a month, cancel any time. A [beginner real estate course offer](https://study.richdad.com/re-course-offer) listed $27 for a five-part video. Coaching and live events are marketed on other Rich Dad URLs without a clear public tuition on the pages we opened. If someone quotes a five-figure 'Rich Dad seminar' price, ask for the live invoice. We will not invent it.
Tom Wheelwright, CPA, is a named Rich Dad advisor and sells tax education at WealthAbility. That is adjacent, not a clone of the novel.

blocks.heading: Better next steps than another mindset book

items.name: BiggerPockets free content
items.summary: Forums and podcasts teach models: house hacking, long-term rentals, short-term rentals. See [BiggerPockets vs Rich Dad](/compare/biggerpockets-vs-rich-dad).

items.name: Tax-Free Wealth / WealthAbility
items.summary: Wheelwright's book is the tax companion many Rich Dad readers buy next. [WealthAbility Live](https://www.wealthability.com/wealthability-live/) lists $197 a month. A [Tax-Free Formula digital page](https://www.wealthability.com/new-tax-free-formula/) lists $497 lifetime access. Mentorship pages we opened did not publish a price.
items.meta: Job: tax education from a CPA brand

items.name: The Money Guy FOO
items.summary: If the book made you hate saving, you still need an order for the next paycheck. The [FOO guide](https://moneyguy.com/guide/foo/) is free and updated in 2026.
items.meta: Job: what to do with this month's dollar

items.name: Brandon Turner's rental books and BetterLife
items.summary: Turner's rental books are often the mechanical sequel people name. BetterLife coaching did not publish a price on the pages we opened. Read the book before any call.

items.name: Legacy Wealth Blueprint
items.summary: Our plan for people who already earn well and need tax, debt, and investing in one order. Price we publish: $9,800. Not a replacement for reading Rich Dad. A replacement for stacking random courses.
items.meta: Job: one written plan. We sell this.

blocks.label: Sales calls after a cheap video
paragraphs: Cheap $17 or $27 offers sometimes sit in front of a longer sales path. That is legal. It is also how people overpay. Take a night. Read the [FTC coaching page](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/when-business-offer-or-coaching-program-scam). If they rush you, walk.

whoFits: You finished Rich Dad Poor Dad and you want a how-to, not another parable.
You can tell the difference between a $27 video and a coaching call.
whoSkips: You have not read the book yet and you want us to review it as if we were a shopper. Read the book. It is short.
You want us to claim Kiyosaki's personal net worth. We will not. We cannot verify it from a primary filing we opened.

questionsBeforeBuying: Did the book already change my view, and do I now need mechanics?
Is this $17 or $27 offer the whole product, or a door to a call?
If I want tax help, am I buying a CPA's class or a story about taxes?
Can I name one property or one tax form I will work on this month?
nextSteps: If you want rental mechanics, use [BiggerPockets alternatives](/compare/biggerpockets-alternatives) and the [rental cash flow calculator](/tools/rental-property-cash-flow).

If you want tax mechanics, open the [short-term rental loophole guide](/tax-strategies/short-term-rental-loophole) only if you will own a short-stay property. Otherwise start with [HSA strategy](/tax-strategies/hsa-strategy).
Read [BiggerPockets vs Rich Dad](/compare/biggerpockets-vs-rich-dad) before you buy both.

faqs.q: Is Rich Dad Poor Dad still worth reading?
faqs.a: As a short mindset book, many investors still start there. As a buying manual, no. You need another source for offers, loans, and tax.

faqs.q: How much is Rich Dad coaching?
faqs.a: We could not copy a public coaching tuition from the homepages we opened. Digital offers showed $17 a month and $27. Ask for the full price in writing if a call starts.

faqs.q: Is Tax-Free Wealth a Rich Dad alternative or part of the same world?
faqs.a: Both. Wheelwright is a Rich Dad advisor, and WealthAbility is his company. Use it as tax school, not as a second novel.

cta.body: If you want mechanics for tax and cash flow, use the strategy library. If you want one written plan, read how Blueprint works. Neither one replaces a licensed tax pro.
